verdict.rationale: turbopuffer's docs show dense and sparse vector search (docs-1), BM25 full-text search (docs-15), and multi-queries that send several queries to one namespace for hybrid search (docs-20). They also document server-side rank fusion via RRF plus native reranking (docs-16), which covers dense+keyword fusion in one request. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of hybrid fusion quality, and detail on fusion configuration beyond RRF (e.g., weighting between dense and BM25 signals).
